model_annotation:
Both subplots display training reward trajectories as a function of training progress, with a shared x-axis labeled “Steps” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with major tick labels at regular 100-step intervals (0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500). The top panel is titled “Easy Training Set” and the bottom panel is titled “Hard Training Set,” and each contains two solid lines (no point markers) with semi-transparent shaded bands in the corresponding colors around each line.

In the “Easy Training Set” plot, the y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale spanning approximately 0.0 to 0.45, with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4. A blue solid line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises to roughly 0.25 by about 100 steps, increases further to around 0.33–0.35 by about 200 steps, and then fluctuates in the mid-to-high 0.3 range, ending near approximately 0.36–0.37 at step 500. A red solid line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” also starts near 0.0 at step 0, rises to roughly 0.20 by about 50 steps and around 0.23–0.25 by about 100 steps, continues upward to around 0.30 by about 200 steps, then oscillates in the mid 0.3 range with several higher excursions, reaching around 0.40 near the right side of the plot and ending close to about 0.41–0.42 at step 500.

In the “Hard Training Set” plot, the y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards” on a linear scale spanning approximately 0.0 to 0.22, with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.1, and 0.2. A blue solid line labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” begins around 0.03 at step 0, declines toward 0.0 over the early part of training (reaching near-zero by roughly 80–100 steps), and remains essentially at 0.0 through approximately the first ~180 steps, after which the blue trace is not visibly continued in the panel. A red solid line labeled “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” starts near 0.0 at step 0, increases to about 0.09–0.10 by around 60–80 steps, rises to roughly 0.12–0.13 by about 150 steps, continues upward with fluctuations around roughly 0.14–0.17 across the mid-range of steps, shows higher peaks around approximately 0.18–0.19 in the 300–400 step region, and ends near about 0.20–0.21 at step 500.
